title: Communication audiences
slide_intent: Teach writers to judge how much context a reader needs. A first encounter, a continuing relationship and a professional partnership call for different levels of detail.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can explain itself plainly to newcomers while giving members and partners the information their roles require.
demonstration: Three columns pair circular illustrations with audience labels and short descriptions. The left note asks the reader to consider audience familiarity when choosing detail and language.
practical_value: Choose the level of explanation for the general public, members and supporters, or sponsors and partners before drafting the message.
